Yamuna River Pollution Levels Show Slight Decrease in July

The Yamuna River's faecal coliform levels saw a marginal decrease in July, according to the Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC). While the pollution levels have shown a slight decline, they remain high. The DPCC reported these findings based on water quality tests conducted in July.
